history.body: Hi, I’ve been comparing condo prices around Seberang Jaya and Pearl Residences looks on the higher side. What would make it good value compared with other options?

Fair question—if Pearl is higher, value comes down to what the difference gets you, not just the headline price. Phase 1 units are 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony; listed shared facilities include community halls, a playground, surau and tadika. That gives us a basis to compare the homes and facilities, but I wouldn’t call it better value without checking the actual price and ongoing charges against the alternatives. I’ll verify the current pricing; if you share the condo or condos you’re comparing, I can line them up fairly.

I don’t have specific condo names shortlisted yet—I’ve just been browsing listings and comparing rough prices. The 900 sq ft and facilities are useful context, but I’m still trying to understand the full cost before I can tell whether the comparison is fair.

That makes sense—you need the ongoing costs as well as the asking price to compare fairly. The known maintenance rate is RM0.18 per sq ft, inclusive of sinking fund; for a 900 sq ft unit, that’s about RM162 a month if the full built-up area is used for billing. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, so usage isn’t automatically part of everyone’s fixed maintenance charge. That’s only part of the picture, though: without confirmed current pricing and the applicable charges, I can’t give you a reliable full ownership total yet.
